name: footer-trust-marks
title: Trust marks footer
description: A footer with a row of quality marks and memberships drawn as quiet, named tiles, for businesses where credentials decide the sale.
docs: Pass the link columns and the marks ({ label, issuer, href, image, since }). A tile shows the issuer's artwork, greyed, when you pass image, and the issuer as a clean text mark when you do not; the issuer is the tile's accessible name, label sits under it, and since is written "Since 2014" (labels.since translates it). A mark with href links to its entry in the issuer's register and opens in a new tab. Every tile is one size, so mixed artwork lines up, and nothing animates. Artwork should be dark on a clear ground: the tile turns it grey, and light in the dark theme. From md up the tiles sit in a grid whose columns follow how many marks there are, so the last row is full: one row for four or five, three by two for six (one row of six from xl), two rows of four for seven or eight. On a phone the row scrolls sideways with fading edges, and when no mark is a link that row gets a focus stop of its own so the keyboard can scroll it; the grid, which does not scroll, never gets one. No state of its own, so it renders on the server.
